ai_summary.text:
長谷川香料は香料の国内大手メーカーで、食品用フレーバーと香粧品用フレグランスの製造を主力としている。飲料・菓子・調味料向けの食品香料と、化粧品・トイレタリー向けの香粧品香料を両軸に展開しており、独自の調香技術と天然素材の分析技術で差別化を図っている。高砂香料工業と並ぶ国内香料業界の有力企業として安定した顧客基盤を持つ。

売上735億円（前年比+2.6%）と堅調な増収を確保。営業利益85億円（営業利益率11.6%）と高い利益率を達成し、純利益69億円と安定した利益水準を維持。食品向けフレーバーの安定需要が業績を堅実に支えている。ROE5.6%と安定した資本効率を実現。

自己資本比率83.5%と極めて高い水準にあり、財務健全性スコア93点と非常に健全な財務基盤。営業CF112億円、FCF43億円と安定したキャッシュ創出力を確保。EPS170円に対しPER17.2倍、配当74円で配当性向は約44%。高い利益率と極めて堅牢な財務基盤を併せ持ち、食品・化粧品産業の安定した香料需要が中長期の事業基盤を盤石なものとしている。
ai_summary.text_en: Hasegawa Fragrance is a major domestic fragrance manufacturer with food flavorings and fragrance products for cosmetics as main operations. Operating on dual axes of food fragrances for beverages, confectioneries and seasonings alongside cosmetic and toiletry fragrances, the company differentiates through unique fragrance composition technology and natural material analysis capabilities. As a leading industry company alongside Takasago International alongside Takasago International, it maintains a stable customer base.  Revenue of 73.5 billion yen (up 2.6% YoY) secured steady growth. Operating profit of 8.5 billion yen (operating margin 11.6%) achieved high profitability, with net profit of 6.9 billion yen maintaining stable profit levels. Steady demand for food flavorings solidly supported results. ROE of 5.6% realized stable capital efficiency.  Equity ratio of 83.5% is at an exceptionally high level, with financial health score of 93 points indicating very sound financial foundation. Operating cash flow of 11.2 billion yen and FCF of 4.3 billion yen secure stable cash generation. With EPS of 170 yen against PER of 17.2x and dividend of 74 yen representing payout ratio of approximately 44%, the combination of high profit margins and exceptionally robust financial foundation, supported by stable fragrance demand from food and cosmetics industries, makes the medium- to long-term business foundation unshakeable.
